links.reason: Kar 9's flowers speak இன்சொற் பலவும் (thurai: the friend reassures the heroine), and Akam 74's heroine quotes back the friend's வன்புறை இன்சொல் நன்பல and says she could hold firm வருத்தாக் காலே, were it not for the cowherds' flute. The same reassuring sweet words, in mullai, meet their limit at evening. That is a real qualification.

verses.note: Counted as six recipients of food; line 1 ஈன்றார்ஈன் கால்தளர்வார் divides uncertainly.
Three by the இனிது predicates; lines 3-4 (much grain and true allies) are taken as one item.
Gender tagged for பரந்தொழுகும் பெண்பால், a judgment on a woman's conduct; it is borderline as a rule.
Ascetic vows (not eating, not bathing) are tagged ritual as rules of bodily conduct; line 2 உட்குடைத்தா வென்று is obscure.
பண்போல் கிளவியார் and பண்போலும் சொல்லார் are read as women (a stock epithet), so the warnings are tagged gender; if they mean flatterers there is no norm.
Line 1 is the decade's opening formula, not an item.
The preface praises the author's combining of the household, renunciation and word-dharma texts and the way of release; it counts no counsels, so it has no items, differing from the expected 6 or 5.
Six participles before பழிஇல்லா மன்னனாய்; நுழையா as a separate item is uncertain.
A warning about men's desire, not a rule about women, so no gender norm.
The verse's divisions (நன்றீதல் தீதுபண்(பு) இல்லார்க்கு, the repeated சாலாமை) are very uncertain; five taken by the நன்று/தீது predicates.
Greed for food bringing disease is prudence, not a diet rule.
Five taken from the teacher, the student and the student who learns and casts off the three, against one who does not; the division is uncertain.
The items address the ruler, the ascetic and anyone; tagged all.
தளிசாலை is split as temple and hall to make five; பேரறம் is read as the verdict, not an item.
புலால் மயங்கான் (not eating flesh) is tagged diet.
A definition of the teacher (ஆசாரியன்) with four marks, not 6 or 5; domain ascetic for a religious teacher of doctrine is a judgment call.
